According to legend, the Trojan prince Paris killed Achilles by shooting him in the heel with an arrow.

According to later legends (and bits and pieces of Homer’s own Odyssey), the warrior returned to Troy after Hector’s funeral to exact further revenge for Patroclus’ death.
